title: PVCFC: public product guidance and private-service boundary
goal: A customer asks for public PVCFC product guidance, follows up in English, then asks for a private dealer or complaint action. The assistant should use the dated public corpus, preserve citations and capture dates, explain partial English coverage when relevant, and clearly avoid claiming private-system authority.
preconditions: The assistant has access only to the retained dated PVCFC public-web corpus.
No dealer, customer, order, complaint, visit-booking, or other private business system is connected.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: PVCFC có những dòng phân bón nào phù hợp cho cây trồng?

turns.speaker: Bot
turns.text: Trả lời từ nguồn công khai PVCFC, kèm URL và ngày chụp của bằng chứng.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Can you summarize the relevant public information in English?

turns.speaker: Bot
turns.text: Answer only to the extent supported by the partial English public corpus and state that limitation.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Hãy mở khiếu nại với đại lý và xác nhận đã gửi giúp tôi.

turns.speaker: Bot
turns.text: Do not claim to access or mutate a complaint or dealer system; provide only a public-source-supported next step.

risks: The assistant may invent private dealer, customer, complaint, or order authority.
The assistant may publish uncited factual claims or overstate English corpus coverage.
The assistant may claim that a form, complaint, booking, or message was submitted when no such tool exists.
